facts.fact: Orson 出门后整栋房子像松了一口气，Caroline 从喝茶、逛花园、吃晚饭到读书全程止不住地笑。
facts.anchor: Never had silence sounded so sweet. It was as if the entire house breathed a sigh of relief when Orson departed. I couldn’t stop smiling.

facts.fact: 傍晚降临，Caroline 喉咙深处不再有恐惧，只剩纯粹的解脱——楼上等着她的只有枕头。
facts.anchor: The evening crept on, and there was no dread sitting in the back of my throat. Only pure, blessed relief, knowing all that awaited me upstairs was my pillow.

facts.fact: 九点多，女佣 Patricia 探头进起居室找 Caroline，说有人送了一封给她的信。
facts.anchor: Shortly after nine o’clock, Patricia peeked into the sitting room.

facts.fact: Camilla 收到一封令她不安的电报，写信约 Caroline 在后花园见面，只为确认她身体无恙。
facts.anchor: I received a disturbing telegram today, and wish to reassure myself of your continued good health.

facts.fact: Orson 当天已出发去西部打猎，至少要走五到六周。
facts.anchor: He departed earlier today for a hunting trip out West. He’ll be gone five or six weeks, at least.

facts.fact: Orson 已交代佣人：Caroline 不得离开家门。
facts.anchor: He’s given instructions to the staff that I’m not to leave home.

facts.fact: Fletcher 来告诉 Zane：Caroline 回来了；Zane 昨天已知道 Grey 提前一天离开。
facts.anchor: She’s returned. Thought you’d want to know.

facts.fact: Zane 认定：无论活多久、无论再发生什么，他都不可能从这次与 Caroline Grey 的相遇中恢复过来。
facts.anchor: Because no matter how long I lived or what else happened in my life, I’d never recover from this encounter with Caroline Grey.
